name: PR detail Files changed tab groups the seeded files by role
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab and confirm the Smart Diff view: the section label, the five role groups (read through their hints), the seeded finding under src/config.ts with its 'blocker' line tag, the collapsed Boilerplate group opening onto package-lock.json, and the round trip through Original order (?order=original, a flat list that shows README.md, which smart order keeps collapsed) and back to Smart order. Read-only seeded data: the flow never presses Accept, Dismiss or Run Review, so no model call and nothing the other flows read changes. The nine seeded files and the finding come from e2e/specs/seed-fixtures.md ('PR #482 has nine files, one or more per role, and two patches'). The section label is uppercased by CSS and agent-browser's `wait --text` reads document.body.innerText, so that one step lowercases the page text instead of matching the casing. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
